name: Wooden stool
descriptions: A rough wooden stool, made out of pine.
It seems particularly unstable, but it's still useful for sitting.
The vrnish layer makes it soft to the touch.

name: Bed nook
descriptions: Part of the building, a slab of granite protuding from the floor, with a small individual mattress on top.
The mattress is covered with a soft velvet red cover made out of cotton.
The crammed space is compact but comfortable.
